lines.zh: 释放黑暗能量，缓缓前行。

lines.en: Folding back and forth between stone walls.
Not a sound beneath my feet.
Staring into the distance, hollow gaze.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，似乎有所察觉。

lines.en: Pale hands hanging at my sides.
I count the dripping in the cave.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，缓缓逼近。
lines.en: Eyes locking on player, slowly approaching.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你和门之间来回扫。
lines.en: My eyes flick between you and the door.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，喉咙里咯咯作响。
lines.en: I tilt my head, a rattle rising in my throat.

lines.zh: 我眨眼的时候，你就挪了位置。

lines.en: Staring at player, holding a blade.
The purple light of the End is tainted.

lines.zh: 死死盯住玩家，准备出手。
lines.en: Deadly stare on player, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 我偷你的方块，也偷你的视线。
lines.en: I steal your blocks and your gaze.
Staring at player, holding a blade.
Did you hear me come closer?
Don't look at me too long.
I remember the traces you left.
One step is all that separates us.

lines.zh: 紫色粒子从我的眼睛里漏出来。
lines.en: Purple particles leak from my eyes.

lines.zh: 我的紫色眼睛忽明忽暗。
lines.en: My violet eyes flicker bright and dim.

lines.zh: 黑血溅在石头上，冒起白烟。
lines.en: Black blood spatters the stone and steams.

lines.zh: 我的叫声卡在喉咙里，变成杂音。
lines.en: My scream catches in my throat and turns to static.

lines.zh: 紫影钻进我身体，珠子裂了。
lines.en: The pale shade entered me and my pearl cracked.

lines.zh: 苍白如骨，注视你的心灵！

lines.en: Don't look away, you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 黑暗中寻找迷失的灵魂。
lines.en: Seek lost souls in the dark.

lines.zh: 与我同行，一起扭曲现实。
感知心灵的波动，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Sense the波动, find the prey.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的一抹亮光，引你入坑。
lines.en: A glimmer in the dark, lures you in.

lines.zh: 你触摸我的，将永世不得超生。
lines.en: Touch me, and be forever lost.

lines.zh: 痛苦与恐惧，是你唯一出路。
lines.en: Pain and fear, your only way out.

lines.zh: 你的身体无法承受我的力量。
lines.en: Your body can't withstand my power.

lines.zh: 身体间的摩擦，灵魂的碰撞。
力量的较量，你无法获胜。
肉体与灵魂的碰撞，一触即发。
对抗无法避免，只有毁灭。
你与我，只能有一个活下来。
lines.en: You or me, only one survives.

lines.zh: 同类之间，更深层次的联系。
共同的意志，共同的使命。
灵魂的伴侣，命运的交织。
寻找灵魂伴侣，延续种族。
lines.en: Seek soul mate, continue the race.
No need for words between同类.

lines.zh: 共同的目标，共同的未来。
它扭曲的身影在黑暗中飘荡。
lines.en: Its twisted form drifts in the darkness.

lines.zh: 苍白光芒中闪烁着恶意。
lines.en: Malice flickers in the pale light.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛空洞，目光呆滞。
lines.en: Its eyes are hollow and lifeless.
Its long fingers chill the air.

lines.zh: 它翻着石头，像在找什么。
lines.en: It turns over stones as if searching.
腐朽气息 permeates the area.

lines.zh: 它无声地移动，令人恐惧。

lines.en: It seems to be observing you.

lines.zh: 它紧握着一把尖锐的匕首。

lines.en: Its eyes are filled with hate.
You seem to be its prey.

lines.zh: 紫瞳里那点白，不是末影人的。
lines.en: That white in these violet eyes is not an enderman's.

lines.zh: 苍白光芒聚焦在你身上。
我站在洞穴深处，你后颈发凉了。
lines.en: I stand deep in the cave, and your neck turns cold.
Its hand clutches into a fist.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我已经站在你背后。
lines.en: When you look up, I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 附身的末影人，影子在你身后。
lines.en: A possessed Enderman's shadow is behind you.

lines.zh: 那道苍白的影子转向你。
lines.en: That pale shape has turned toward you.

lines.zh: 被附身的末影人，瞬移近了。

lines.en: It prepares to use the dagger.
Its eyes are filled with intent.
It begins to chant dark spells.
It prepares to unleash its power.
It follows the sound of your breathing.

lines.zh: 用眼睛盯住你，准备攻击
lines.en: Fixing eyes on you, ready to attack

lines.zh: 撕裂你的衣物，如撕纸般
挥舞着末影珍珠，造成混乱

lines.en: That blow carries the cold of the End.
Pale light seeps from the end stone seams.
It comes walking on ender particles.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处多了一道影子。
lines.en: One more shadow deep in the cave.

lines.zh: 火星爬上我的黑皮，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Embers crawl over my black hide, and I flinch.
My violet eyes stay open underwater.

lines.zh: 末地的紫光被染成了白。
lines.en: The End's violet light has been stained pale.

lines.zh: 哀嚎一声，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Screams in pain — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，末影粒子四散。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, scattering ender particles.

lines.zh: 虚空拉住我的脚，我往下沉。
lines.en: The void grabs my feet and pulls me down.
